title: Dental PPO Plans Deductible: Individual and Family Limits
content:
Claims Adjudication Manual, Dental PPO Plans — deductible.

**1. Basis.** The deductible is taken per person per benefit period and is capped for the family.

**2. Amount applied.** On a basic or major line (and on a preventive line only when the plan does not waive the deductible for preventive services), the deductible applied is the smallest of:
- the line's alternate allowance;
- the person's remaining individual deductible (the plan's individual deductible less the deductible the person has already applied in the benefit period);
- the family's remaining deductible (the plan's family deductible maximum less the deductible the family has already applied in the benefit period);

and never less than 0.00. The individual deductible and family deductible maximum of each plan, and whether it waives the deductible for preventive services, are shown in the plan's schedule of benefits.

**3. The family.** The family is every enrollment of the same subscriber funded by the same billing account under the same plan, counted for the same benefit year. When the plan was changed during a benefit period, deductible already satisfied under the prior plan in that benefit period still counts.

**4. Order of lines.** Lines are taken in order of decision date, then claim number, then line number, so the line decided first absorbs the remaining deductible first.

**5. Lines that apply none.** A denied or pended line applies no deductible. A reprocessed line reverses the original line's deductible and applies its own as if decided on its reprocessing date. A plan whose individual deductible is 0.00 takes no deductible on any line.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)
A plan with an individual deductible of 40.00 and a family maximum of 120.00. A person has applied 15.00; the family has applied 110.00. A basic line has an alternate allowance of 62.00. The deductible applied is the smallest of 62.00, 25.00 (40.00 less 15.00) and 10.00 (120.00 less 110.00), which is 10.00.
